pages.text: I can cycle a carried stack through related stone forms.

$(bold)Mana:$() 1⁄20 bucket$(br)$(bold)Mode:$() Instant$(br2)Hold a supported block stack in the offhand and cast. The entire stack advances one step: Stone→Andesite→Diorite→Granite; Cobblestone→Stone Bricks→Cracked→Mossy; Deepslate→Cobbled→Polished→Bricks→Tiles; or the Sandstone and Red Sandstone families. Each family loops.
